phase1.title: Reception / Case Manager
phase1.description: A ticket is created with the selected service, a QR code is generated, and the ticket number is displayed to the customer.
phase1.eligibilityDesc: Verify customer service eligibility before creating a ticket.
phase1.qrTicketDesc: Generate QR-coded tickets with service type and estimated wait time.
phase1.queueMgmtDesc: Assign customers to appropriate service lines with real-time position tracking.
phase1.notificationsDesc: Send real-time updates via QR code scans when customer's turn approaches.

phase2.title: Archiver / Documentation
phase2.description: The archiver claims the ticket, fetches and verifies the required documents, and marks the case as ready.
phase2.documentsDesc: Gather all supporting documents and attachments for completed cases.
phase2.complianceDesc: Verify that all required documents meet compliance standards and completeness.
phase2.archiveDesc: Securely store and organize archived documents for future retrieval.

phase3.title: Teller / Service Delivery
phase3.description: The teller calls the ticket, serves the customer, and documents the interaction.
phase3.ticketCallDesc: Automatically call tickets in order with visual and audio alerts.
phase3.caseWorkflowDesc: Document service interactions and capture outcomes in real-time.
phase3.analyticsDesc: Track service times, customer satisfaction, and operational metrics.
